newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Mobtel signs roaming deal with UK Cellnet.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Mobtel signs roaming deal with UK Cellnet.

text.p: The Yugoslav GSM mobile phone operator Mobtel said on Thursday it had signed a roaming deal with Britain's Cellnet, allowing all Serbian clients to use the Cellnet network as of June 11.
Before the deal with Cellnet, Yugoslav GSM phone subscribers used the Hungarian network Westel 900, Mobtel said in a statement.
Cellnet is jointly owned by BT and Securicor Group Plc.

Mobtel, until recently the only GSM mobile telephony operator in Serbia, also said it has been testing the possibility of linking with the Austrian and Greek networks and negotiations were underway with GSM operators in Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Netherlands, Bulgaria, Macedonia and Belgium.

Since June 9, Mobtel has a competitor in providing GSM services, after Telekom Srbija sold 49 percent of its stake to the Italian telecom company Stet and OTE of Greece in a strategic partnership deal which provides Telekom Srbija with a 20-year licence for a GSM mobile telephony network. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
